turktrust.plainHttp: Over plain HTTP the TÜRKTRUST username and password cross the network unencrypted, in clear text. Choose it only if HTTPS cannot be used, and switch back to HTTPS as soon as you can.

note.title: Verify on site (sahada doğrula)
note.body: Some of TÜRKTRUST's behaviour is not confirmed by this installation; check it with the first stamp test. The host is zd.turktrust.com.tr; the path of the address is unknown, by default /. If TÜRKTRUST gives another path, write it into [tsa] url in arcilogger.toml on the server console. The answer for an empty balance is unknown; a rejection whose status text contains a credit word counts as no credit. Plain HTTP uses port 80, HTTPS port 443. Details: turktrust.md section 2.

errors.turktrustUsername: The username must be 1–128 characters with no control characters.
errors.turktrustPassword: The password must be 1–256 characters with no control characters.
errors.crlUrl: Each line must be an address that starts with http:// or https:// and names a host; it cannot contain a user name or password.
errors.crlUrlsCount: At most {{max}} addresses can be entered.

evidence.title: Re-stamping and revocation lists
evidence.description: For long-term evidence: stamps are re-stamped before their certificates expire, and the revocation lists (CRLs) of the stamp certificates are fetched every day. Applies to both providers.
evidence.renewBeforeDaysHint: {{min}}–{{max}} days, default 180. Stamps whose certificate expires in fewer days are re-stamped; at most one stamp a day is used.
evidence.crlMaxAgeDaysHint: {{min}}–{{max}} days, default 7. A revocation list counts as current while its last successful fetch and verification is newer than this and the list's own next update (nextUpdate) has not passed; otherwise a warning is raised.
evidence.crlUrlsHint: One address per line, with http:// or https://; at most {{max}} addresses. Left empty, the CRL distribution points in the certificates of the root certificates and of the newest stamps are used.
evidence.crlNote: The revocation list addresses of Kamu SM and TÜRKTRUST are not confirmed for this installation; ARCILOGGER adds no address of its own. Enter the addresses the provider publishes here and check the result after the first fetch.
evidence.reauth: Changing these settings asks for your password again.

network.title: Network
network.description: The proxy for the server's outbound connections.
network.proxyHint: As http://host:port; left empty, no proxy is used. No user name or password is taken. The revocation list fetch and the RFC 3161 and TÜRKTRUST time-stamp requests use it.
network.zamaneNote: The Kamu SM Zamane client does not use this proxy, because how the client takes a proxy is not confirmed. With Kamu SM in use, the server needs a direct outbound connection to Kamu SM.
network.reauth: Changing the proxy asks for your password again.

errors.proxy: Enter an address as http://host:port (a host name or IPv4 address, a port from 1 to 65535), or leave the field empty.
